text:
emily: Internal announcement: Private/VPC Licensing & Compliance addendum is approved for GA. Key points: signed addendum required for all Private GA customers, mandatory KMS/HSM or approved BYOK flow, and an updated data-retention opt-in for EU installs. Docs: https://internal.redwood.io/policy/private-licensing-addendum
legal-bot: Doc uploaded: private-licensing-addendum v1.0 by emily — 1779300000
rohan: Question: do existing pilots need to sign the addendum retroactively?
emily: Short answer: pilots will receive a grace period. We require executed addendum before full GA SLA is granted. Timeline in doc: 45 days from GA notice.
tara: Ops note: onboarding UI will show an "Accept Addendum" step. If not accepted within 45 days, customer's Private instance will be limited to read-only snapshot exports. Will add copy to UI team.
zach: Security ask: BYOK approval needs a vetting step. Who owns that?
emily: Security (zach) will own BYOK vetting; we added a simple intake form and sample PKCS11 proof-of-possession steps in the doc.
legal-bot: EU-specific clause: added explicit backup opt-in and data transfer disclosure. Legal requests product to expose opt-in checkbox during enablement.
ops-bot: Automation: created a ticket template for onboarding that includes: KMS check, signed addendum, backup opt-in. Ticket #ONBOARD-PAK-001 created.
rohan: Billing question: is there any pricing change for Private GA tied to HSM usage?
emily: No pricing changes today; Finance will surface any future HSM surcharge separately. For now we treat HSM as compliance requirement only.
tara: Scheduling: we'll roll the UI change in next week's sprint. Emily I'll need final copy by EOD Monday.
emily: I'll post the final snippets and the legal-approved checklist to the doc thread by Monday morning. Also scheduling a 30m all-hands Q&A for Private GA policy next Wed 10:00 PT. Invite will go out.
zach: I'll prepare BYOK vetting steps and short checklist for field engs.
emily: Thanks everyone  please flag blockers here. :lock: :calendar:
